metadata.documentation: Preliminary high-rate (> 0.5 Hz) surface meteorology and flux data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the INFUSSE campaign. The winds reported by the 3D sonic anemometers have been rotated to geographic coordinates. Please check the ISARRA project website for more information.
